title: Artsy Cottage—King bed, Pet-friendly, Fenced yard
description:
This cozy retreat features a king and queen bed, perfect for a small group of guests. Enjoy the convenience of high speed WiFi, a fully equipped kitchen, and a washing machine/dryer during your stay. With a relaxing bathtub to unwind in and a fireplace to enjoy, this amazing property is an ideal home base for your Nashville adventure. Make your holiday one for the books with a stay at our place.

The space
Discover the beauty of Nashville from our pet-friendly 2-bedroom cottage with a fully fenced backyard.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire cottage, the garden, front and back porches, and backyard.
